pb_content_3d_car_body.pb_content_body: People told us the forms were too long. Most gave up before the second page, and many called us instead.
We cut the form to one page and asked only what we need. Everything else can wait until later.
The work took six weeks and a small team. We reused the parts that already worked well.
Calls about the form fell by half in the first month. More people finished it on their own.
Ask fewer questions, and ask them plainly. Test each change with real people before it goes live.
We will apply the same steps to the booking pages. You can follow the work in our monthly notes.
Small groups and patient guides, with time to ask every question.
Paths, benches and shade, open every day from early morning.
Books, films and music, with a reading room that stays calm.
Daylight rooms by the hour for painting, music or a quiet meeting.
Local coffee, fresh bread and soup made in our kitchen each morning.
Stone, steel and glass chosen to stand for a hundred years.
The main hall stays open late every Friday, with live music.
Five days of talks, demos and hands-on sessions for every team.
Forty floors of daylight studios above the old market square.
Twelve weeks of making, from first sketch to finished piece.

One booking system for nine clinics, cutting wait times by a third.
Renewals, events and records in one place for 12,000 members.
Clear signs and maps across 80 stations, tested with riders.
